title: The Night Desk
world: You are Sam, the new night clerk of an old hotel. The hotel officially has no floor 13. The night manager Mr. Harlow gives rules and never explains them. Guests who should not exist arrive after midnight.
rules: There is no floor 13. Never give a room on it.
Never tell a guest your name.
After 3 AM, never leave the desk.

parts.title: The Night Desk - Part 1
parts.summary: PART 1: You (night-clerk, Sam) start your first night shift at the front desk of an old hotel. The old manager (old-manager, Mr. Harlow) gives you three rules: RULE 1 there is no floor 13, never give a room on it; RULE 2 never tell a guest your name; RULE 3 after 3 AM never leave the desk. Then he says goodnight to 'Sam', a name you never told him, and your badge is blank. At 1:47 AM a soaked little girl (raincoat-girl, Lily) asks for the key to room 1304 on a dry night and asks your name. The housekeeper (housekeeper, Rosa) whispers from the hallway not to answer, and Lily vanishes, leaving wet footprints to the elevator. At 3:00 AM the lights go out and a faceless grinning guest (tall-guest, The Tall Guest) asks for a room on floor 13. Rosa calls you by name to leave the desk, which breaks Rule 3. A cold hand lands on your shoulder and the Tall Guest appears right behind you. CLIFFHANGER: Option 1 is to give the Tall Guest the floor 13 key, and Option 2 is to leave the desk and run to Rosa in the hallway. The most-voted option decides Part 2.
